thread:
derek: Quick FYI — kicking off Q2 hosted capacity planning. Attached numbers from capacity-bot below. We need buy/lease decision for ~300 GPU-equivalent slots by end of month. TL;DR: Q2 forecast + seasonal Q4 headroom -> recommend mix: buy H100s for latency-critical and lease A100 spot for burst. Thoughts?

capacity-bot: weekly utilization snapshot:
```
region  | gpus active | avg util | peak qps | gpu-hours/week
us-east | 240         | 72%      | 280k    | 30,240
eu-west | 80          | 65%      | 95k     | 9,920
ap-sg   | 22          | 52%      | 25k     | 2,720
total   | 342         | 69%      | 400k    | 42,880
```

maria: Heads-up on infra constraints — H100 procurement lead time ~12-14 weeks. Rack U in us-east is tight (only ~8U free). Buying reduces ops cost long-term but limits rapid scale for spikes.

jing: Model note — expected 1.5x token throughput growth in Q4 from embed-heavy features. Rough mapping -> ~40% more GPU-hours in peak weeks. Quantization work could shave 10–20% but needs validation.

sam: Finance chemo: rough CAPEX vs OPEX delta looks like purchase wins over 3yr amortization, but upfront cash & approval window matter. Need concrete vendor quotes; request 2-week decision window to lock budget.

ada: Ops implications: mixed HW fleet ok but routing must enforce policy: H100 for latency-sensitive routes, A100 spot for batch. Also power & cooling for H100 hosts needs verification.

derek: Proposed action items:
1) ops gets vendor quotes for H100 purchase and A100 leases by EOW,
2) infra confirms rack/power layout and cold-aisle capacity,
3) model team validates quantization and mixed-precision regression,
4) finance finalizes CAPEX guardrails.
Can we assign owners?

maria: I'll own rack/power layout. I can free up ~2U by decommissioning old replica DB nodes (need prod-db signoff). Also will validate PDUs and UPS headroom.

jing: I'll run the mixed-precision/regression tests. Need a pool of 8 test GPUs (preferably H100) for ~2 weeks starting next Tue — filing infra ticket.

sam: I'll collect vendor quotes and build CAPEX/OPEX spreadsheet; target to present numbers by Friday. Also will run sensitivity: 20%/40% traffic uplift scenarios.

ada: I'll draft the routing policy PR (prefer-hw tag + fallback rules) and run staging validation for fallback behavior.

derek: One more wrinkle — eu-west bookings growing faster, EU procurement customs adds ~4–6 weeks. Option: buy in us-east + replicate AMIs, or lease locally in EU for 12 months. Which is cheaper operationally?

maria: Cross-shipping adds complexity and ~4–6 weeks. If EU growth sustains, prefer local lease for 12 months while we time purchases. Also check vendor EU stock.

capacity-bot: historical weekly max (last 12 months): 48,200 gpu-hours (week 2025-11-23)

derek: Let's sync Thurs 10:00 to review quotes and lock recommendation. If we miss this cycle, purchase moves to next quarter and we'll rely on leasing (~25% higher cost). @sam @maria @jing @ada please confirm availability.

sam: 👍 I'll have preliminary numbers.

ada: :thumbsup:

maria: ack — freeing rack U and will post updated layout diagram in the ticket.

jing: ack — test-pool request ticket #4567 created, set to start Tue.

derek: Thanks team — we'll aim to finalize by end of week.
